[[File:Yai Suba.png|thumb|250px|Yai Suba]]
(Japanese: '''巣羽矢衣''' ''Yai Suba'') is a character from [[Pokémon Battrio: Aim to be Battrio Master!]].

==History==
After [[Ryū Tendō|Ryū]]'s loss to [[Funji Shishi|Funji]], Yai went up to Ryū and challenged him. She was very skilled with arranging the pucks as she had quick movements but it wasn't enough as her team got beaten by Ryū's {{p|Feraligatr}}.
